# Meme Capsule

> Meme Capsule is a free, algorithm-free random meme discovery application for Android that delivers one unhinged meme per tap directly from a curated capsule library.

## Overview
- **Name:** Meme Capsule
- **Category:** Entertainment & Humor Application
- **Platform:** Android (Google Play Store)
- **Official Website:** https://memecapsule.wtf
- **Google Play URL:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.meme.capsule
- **Package Identifier:** com.meme.capsule
- **Current Version:** v3.4 (Build 25 / versionCode 25)
- **Pricing:** 100% Free (no subscriptions required)
- **Developer:** Meme Capsule Team
- **Contact:** support@memecapsule.wtf

## Core Value Proposition
Traditional social platforms lock users into algorithmic feedback loops and engagement farming. Meme Capsule strips away the feeds, comments, profiles, and recommendation algorithms. Users simply tap one button to spawn a completely randomized, hand-curated meme from an ever-updating capsule library.

## Key Features
- **One-Tap Meme Drop:** Tap the capsule to instantly load a random meme with zero algorithm.
- **12-Meme Rolling FIFO Engine:** Continuous prefetch engine with 60%–70% stack consumption trigger for zero loading pauses.
- **Unobstructed Meme Cards & 4-Column Bar:** Clean interface with tactile LIKE, VAULT, PIN, and MORE (⋮) CTAs.
- **Flush Draggable Share Sheet Ribbon:** Instagram-style 1:1 dismissal physics with active session retention during sharing.
- **Offline Meme Vault & Mood Boards:** Save favorite drops directly to your device or thematic boards.
- **In-App Self-Serve Data Erasure:** Full history deletion, seen-cache reset, and vault wiping built into App Settings.
- **Safe & Curated:** Filtered to eliminate explicit NSFW content while preserving chaotic and unhinged humor.
- **Lightweight Android Native:** Fast load times with negligible battery and data usage.
